stem: According to the speaker, climbing a tree can be difficult because —

options.label: F
options.text: the bark on the tree is rough

options.label: G
options.text: there are too many people trying to climb the tree

options.label: H
options.text: there is not a lot of space to move around in some areas of the tree

options.label: J
options.text: the leaves on the tree do not provide enough shade from the sun
